About

Engineering graduate, shipped builder

I'm a Computer Engineering graduate from BUITEMS with a 3.92 CGPA and a continuous merit scholarship. My work sits between two things: shipping real products for real clients, and researching machine learning seriously enough to get it published.

On the applied side, I've built a production food-ordering app for a paying client and a geospatial crime-mapping platform that combines anomaly detection, predictive risk modelling, and an LLM-powered route-planning assistant. On the research side, my comparative study of ML and deep learning models for human activity recognition was published at IEEE ICOSST 2025.

Right now I'm doing contract full-stack work — Flutter, FastAPI, React, and LLM integrations — while I apply for funded Masters programs in AI/ML and Geospatial Intelligence.

02 / Final year project · 2-person team
Crime-o-Graphy — AI crime-mapping platform
FlutterFastAPIMongoDBGemini APIOSRMGoogle Maps SDK

A mobile crime-mapping system I architected with one teammate, combining spatial ML with an LLM layer for decision support.

Built: Random Forest for hotspot prediction and Isolation Forest for spatial anomaly detection; Gemini API for automated incident-report summarisation; Gemini + OSRM together to recommend optimised patrol routes; dynamic density heatmaps and cluster visualisation on the Google Maps SDK.

Outcome: REST APIs on FastAPI with a 40% faster backend response time through async operations and optimised routing; MongoDB for fast geo-queries at map-render speed.
